newsitem.title: USA: Genesee & Wyoming to bid for Australian RR.
newsitem.headline: Genesee & Wyoming to bid for Australian RR.

text.p: Genesee & Wyoming Inc confirmed published articles in the Australian press in a statement on Thursday that it was preparing a bid for the purchase of Australian National's SA Rail and Tasrail properties.
Australian National operates freight railroads in the states of South Australia (known as SA Rail) and Tasmania (known as Tasrail). It also has passenger rail operations, which GWI is not pursuing.

The Commonwealth of Australia, owner of Australian National, has solicited separate tender offers for the three operations. Bids are to be submitted on July 28. It is anticipated the winning bidder will be announced late August.
Genesee is a short line and regional freight railroad company that operates over 1,500 miles of track in western New York, Pennsylvania, Illinois, Louisiana, Texas and Oregon.
